blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sales tax or VAT is added to the price when you buy something. In the UK, VAT is usually 20% on most goods and services. The shop collects the tax from the customer. Then the shop sends it to the tax office every quarter.

For a company, VAT flows both ways. When the company buys things, it pays VAT to its suppliers. When it sells things, it collects VAT from its customers. At the end of the quarter, it pays the difference to the tax office. Sometimes it paid more than it collected, so it gets a refund.

VAT looks invisible on the receipt. But for the accountant, it is one of the most constant and repetitive tasks of the year.

items.q: When is sales tax or VAT added to the price?
options: At the end of the year
items.why: "Sales tax or VAT is added to the price when you buy something."

items.q: In the UK, how much is VAT on most goods and services?
items.why: "VAT is usually 20% on most goods and services."

items.q: When does the company get a refund?
options: When it paid more VAT than it collected
items.why: "Sometimes it paid more than it collected, so it gets a refund."

items.q: The text says VAT is "invisible on the receipt". This suggests that…
options: the customer does not always notice it
items.why: Inferência: "invisible" quer dizer que o cliente não repara no imposto, mas ele está lá.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that VAT for an accountant is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto chama a tarefa de "constant and repetitive" — algo que se repete sempre.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver explicando ao júnior. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, come and sit here. Today I want to show you how we build one VAT return. It is not hard, but you must be careful.

Look at this pile of paper. On the left, these are the invoices for the things we bought this quarter. On these invoices, we paid VAT to our suppliers. On the right, these are our sales. On our sales, we collected VAT from our customers.

So the job is simple. First, I add all the VAT we collected. Then I add all the VAT we paid. Then I take the difference. Most of the time, we collected more than we paid, so we send that money to the tax office.

But sometimes we paid more than we collected. In that quarter, the tax office sends money back to us. That is a refund.

I do this every three months. It is repetitive, yes, but every number must be correct. One wrong invoice, and the whole return is wrong.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Oliver showing the junior?
options: How to build one VAT return
items.why: "Today I want to show you how we build one VAT return."

items.q: What are the invoices on the left?
items.why: "these are the invoices for the things we bought this quarter."

items.q: How often does Oliver do this job?
items.why: "I do this every three months." — um trimestre.

items.q: Why does Oliver say "you must be careful"?
options: Because the tax office is far away
Because the paper is very heavy
Because one wrong invoice makes the whole return wrong
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "every number must be correct. One wrong invoice, and the whole return is wrong."

items.q: What does Oliver think about the work?
options: It is repetitive but must be exact
It is fun and always different
It is a waste of time
items.why: Inferência: "It is repetitive, yes, but every number must be correct."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The shop must collect the tax from every customer." To collect means to…
items.why: To collect = coletar, receber o dinheiro do cliente.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We send the VAT to the ___ every quarter."
items.why: Tax office = receita, para onde o imposto é enviado.

items.q: "A quarter is three months of the year." This word means…
items.why: Quarter = trimestre, um quarto do ano.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We paid more than we collected, so we got a ___."
items.why: Refund = reembolso, o dinheiro que volta.

items.q: "VAT is added to most goods and services." This means…
options: products and work you pay for
items.why: Goods and services = bens (produtos) e serviços (trabalho).

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no dia a dia do escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the VAT return." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "Please fill in this form with the numbers." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações.

items.q: "The tax office will pay back the extra VAT." To pay back means to…
items.why: Pay back = devolver o dinheiro (aqui, o reembolso).

items.q: "We need to add up all the invoices." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, chegar ao total.

items.q: "Let's go over the numbers again before we send them." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, checar com cuidado.
